title: eichlerina rhynchophylla
intro: Eichlerina rhynchophylla, commonly known as the Rhynchophylla plant, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to help manage fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Eichlerina rhynchophylla include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and its antioxidant properties help protect the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Eichlerina rhynchophylla include lignans and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
